subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who regards the world as his country
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cosmopolitan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Cosmopolitan"** refers to someone who is at ease in any part of the world and has an international outlook, which aligns with the concept of regarding the world as one's country. (सर्वदेशीय)

 
 
• **​For example:** She has a cosmopolitan outlook, having lived in many countries around the world.
 
 
 
• This term is often used to describe individuals who have an international outlook and experience in multiple cultures.

​Therefore, the correct answer is:** Cosmopolitan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **"Metropolitan"** person is someone who is associated with a large city, not necessarily with a global or worldly perspective. (महानगरीय)

 
 
• **​For example:** New York is a bustling metropolitan area with diverse cultures.
 
 
 
• An** "Atheist" **is someone who does not believe in the existence of God, which is not related to the idea of global citizenship. (नास्तिक)
 
 
• **​For example: **An atheist does not believe in the existence of a god or gods.
 
 
 
• A **"Philanthropist"** is someone who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes, which does not inherently include a global or worldly perspective. (लोकोपकारक)
 
 
• **​For example:** The philanthropist donated a large sum of money to build the new hospital wing.
